_comment: Find a grant funder name -> 360Giving org id, for `granted run --calls find-a-grant --funder-ids funders.json`. Every id below was confirmed against api.threesixtygiving.org on 2026-09-10 to exist and to have published grants (counts in _verified). Names are written as Find a grant prints them and matched on letters and digits only. Joint funders ('Defra and Innovate UK') are left out on purpose: there is no single award history to judge them against. The British Film Institute and the Forestry Commission are in 360Giving with no grants made, so they cannot be scored. To add a funder, find it on GrantNav and take the org id from its URL. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored.
